original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州集会冲突致一死五伤，奥比要求调查
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州阿萨巴一场政治集会沿线发生冲突，造成一人死亡、五人受伤。警方称已就事件展开调查，并称事前曾收到可能发生暴力的情报、约谈集会组织者并建议不要举行公开游行。集会由Obedient/OK Movement组织，支持尼日利亚民主党总统候选人彼得·奥比。

location.raw_text: Asaba, Delta State, along Nnebisi Road

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州阿萨巴一场政治集会发生冲突，造成一人死亡、五人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Delta State Police Command has commenced an investigation into a clash at a political rally in Asaba, which left one person dead and five others injured.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在周六约12时15分，地点为Nnebisi路，游行由Obedient/OK Movement组织
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The incident occurred at about 12:15 pm on Saturday along Nnebisi Road during a procession organised by the Obedient/OK Movement

key_facts.fact: 警方称事前收到可能发生暴力的情报，并约谈组织者建议不要举行公开游行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the police said they had received intelligence suggesting a likelihood of violence before the rally and invited the organisers to a security meeting

key_facts.fact: 彼得·奥比要求对事件进行调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: One killed, five injured at Delta rally, Obi demands probe

uncertainties: 冲突具体经过与责任方尚未确认
伤亡数字来自警方单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
警方所称事前暴力情报的细节未披露
